original_test_intent: Verify every intended GPU sustains a 12-hour burn at 0C and -5% 5V/3.3V rails, with approved tool PASS and no thermal, power, XID, PCIe or platform fault.
original_method: Record GPU UUID/BDF/topology, driver/firmware and burn-tool provenance; control dew point, cold-soak and measured -5% rails; run approved per-GPU burn for 12 hours with load floors and continuous temperature/power/clock/throttle/ECC/XID/AER/heartbeat data; require tool PASS plus independent health limits, then stop, warm safely and restore nominal state.
manual_activity: Operator controls dry chamber/negative rails, supervises all GPUs and safely warms/restores.
safety_requirements: Control dew point and rail undershoot
Abort on moisture, thermal/power, XID/ECC/AER or heartbeat fault
Warm above dew point before opening chamber
agent_execution_scope: May verify supplied identities/tool artifacts and analyze telemetry
Must not control chamber/rails, launch burn or decide verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct manual boundary; GPU burn needs pinned tool, target scope and command.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run approved burn only after all GPUs and stable dry cold/low-rail conditions are verified.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: GPU burn, 0C, -5% 5V/3.3V and 12 hours are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Evaluate every GPU continuously against synchronized chamber/dew-point/rail telemetry, not only final tool PASS.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds identity, tool provenance, per-GPU health, undervoltage/condensation controls and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One GPU or final process result cannot prove all intended accelerators or exclude transient faults.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Cold/low rails can affect link training or cause throttling/resets that the burn tool may not classify.
